tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i gzungs la phul ba'i yi ge bzhugs// oṃ sarba bitpu ra/ su ra su ra/ arbart+ta ya arbart+ta ya ho/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te badzra sa ra/ pra mardha ni/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddha ya/ ta ya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre mahā badzre/ mahā te dzro badzre/ mahā bidyā badzre/ mahā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ mahā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ tra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma arba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swāhā/ oṃ badzra dharmā rā ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ samp+ra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra/ prā tsa li ni pradzñā pa ra mi ta/ nā da swā bhā we na badzra dharmā hri da ya ni/ santo kha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba bi dyā swāhā/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swāhā/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbhruṃ khāṃ badzri bhā wa tri dhra tiṣṭha bu khaṃ swāhā/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he tunte ṣanta thā ga te hye ba datra/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ ba dī mahā shra ma ṇa/ ngo mtshar mchod pa'i lha mo yid 'ongs 'dis/ /mtshon pa'i dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin gyis/ /srid mtha'i bar du khams gsum kun bkang te/ /bsod nams zhing gyur mchod yul thams cad mchod/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /ngag dbang kun bsod dpon slob gdul byar bcas/ /kun gyi sdig kun byang nas dus 'di la/ /tshe ring nad med bsam pa mthar phyin te/ /phyi ma lhan cig dag pa'i zhing bgrod nas/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /de nyid de bzhin nyid du nges gyur nas/ /de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi yon bdag nged rang gi gzugs kyi nang du gong gi gzungs sngags rnams dang / gzhan yang stod gzungs bar gzungs pad gzungs rnams cha tshang ba/ a ma ra na brgya dang bcu gcig tshigs bcad la/ ngo mtshar mchod pa'i lha mo yid 'ong 'dis/

/zhes pa'i dod maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla 'dis/ /zhes 'don pa bsgyur bas mtshon pa'i man gong dang 'dra ba yod pa bkra shis// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i gzungs la phul ba'i yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
